summary: Create an invented accessory rig with explicit slot rules and reversible changes.
objective: Build a fictional modular camera rig where a handle, monitor and battery attach to named slots.
example_prompts: Build a fictional modular camera rig where a handle, monitor and battery attach to named slots.
Show why an accessory cannot fit an occupied mounting point.

entities.name: Camera cage
entities.guidance: Create frame rails, corner joins and named mount sockets around a camera-shaped body.

entities.name: Accessories
entities.guidance: Distinct monitor frame, battery block and top handle, each with a visible mounting foot.

entities.name: Mount guides
entities.guidance: Show socket axis and occupancy only during attachment.

object_craft.material: Glass-like screen, polymer battery and rubber-looking handle.

state_contract.model: Authored compatibility table keyed by slot type; mounted accessory IDs, rigid local transforms and selected candidate.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Preview an accessory at a socket.
Detach and undo the last change.

invariants: Each slot has at most one attachment and each accessory one parent.
Invalid preview does not mutate committed assembly.
Undo restores occupancy and transforms together.
motion_guidance: Snap only after confirmation of a valid candidate; rejected parts return to their tray.
Keep preview ghost separate from committed meshes and accessible selection labels.
known_limits: Fictional interface dimensions; no claim of compatibility with commercial camera hardware.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Clearly different silhouettes make configuration changes visible without requiring brand assets.

colliders: Attachment envelopes for authored clearance checks.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Occupied slot rejects attach without duplicating the accessory.
